overview.description: The Alps Equal Sector Weight ETF (EQL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund tracks an index of US large-cap companies, from the VettaFi US Equity Large-Cap 500 Index, grouped into the 11 GICS economic sectors. Each sector is equally-weighted with the constituents market cap-weighted within. EQL was launched on Jul 7, 2009 and is issued by SS&C.

data.title: Advisors Rethink Equal Weighting Amid Equity Concentration
data.text: Rising equity concentration is prompting advisors to rethink portfolio construction. However, they also want to avoid simply swapping top-heavy market risk for new factor risks.
